providers.title: OpenAI
providers.notes: Platform API billing and ChatGPT plan allowance stay separate routes. The ChatGPT preview is opt-in and eligibility-gated. GPT Image (route openai-image) and text to speech (openai-speech) are protocol-tested only. The Sora 2 models and the Videos API were shut down on 2026-09-24 with no replacement.

providers.title: Anthropic
providers.notes: A Claude subscription is not an API key; no unofficial Max API proxy is implemented.

providers.title: Google (Gemini)

docs.title: Gemini API thinking and thought signatures

providers.notes: The native generateContent route is implemented; no live Gemini key has exercised it. Thinking stays at the model default. Image and speech use the Interactions API (routes google-image and google-speech, protocol-tested only). Video: the Veo preview models were shut down on 2026-10-22 and Gemini Omni Flash is documented, not built. Provider-native search and grounding are documented only. Consumer CLI sign-in is blocked: Google replaced Gemini CLI with Antigravity CLI on 2026-06-18 and treats third-party use of those OAuth tokens as a terms violation, so Hutch offers no Google coding-CLI route. Vertex AI is a separate catalogue identity.

providers.title: MiniMax
providers.notes: International and China endpoints are distinct; region switching, refresh expiry and account mismatch need explicit recovery. Routes minimax-image and minimax-speech are protocol-tested only; failures arrive inside HTTP 200 bodies. Hailuo video is documented, not built (the query and file-retrieve pages were not read). Music is not built.

providers.title: Moonshot / Kimi
providers.notes: The general Moonshot API (international api.moonshot.ai, China api.moonshot.cn) is a separate platform, key and bill from Kimi Code, which has its own catalogue identity (kimi-coding). A key from one region or platform is not accepted by the other.

providers.title: Kimi Code (membership)
providers.notes: A membership key from the Kimi Code Console, Anthropic Messages at api.kimi.com/coding. Kimi allows membership keys in third-party tools provided the real client identifier is kept; Hutch sends its own and never impersonates another client. Unattended eligibility is Kimi's call. No Kimi key has exercised this route and the vendor model list is not read.

providers.title: Qwen (Alibaba)
providers.notes: Pay-as-you-go OpenAI-compatible routes (Singapore and Beijing hosts) are implemented; keys are region-bound. The Alibaba Coding Plan is blocked: its terms limit the key to interactive use in programming tools and forbid scripts, backends and other non-interactive use, and Hutch bots run unattended. Token Plan keys (sk-sp-) are a separate relationship and are not offered. The old Qwen Portal OAuth is retired and must not be recreated. No Qwen key has exercised this route.

providers.title: xAI (Grok)
providers.notes: Provider-side search and code execution are separately billed tools; they must be shown as such, not folded into model price. Routes xai-image, xai-video and xai-speech are protocol-tested only; the vendor documents no video cancel call. Grok OAuth and speech-to-text are not built.

providers.title: Z.AI (GLM)
providers.notes: The general pay-as-you-go API is offered on the international (api.z.ai) and China (open.bigmodel.cn) hosts. The GLM Coding Plan is blocked: Z.AI says it may only be used within its officially supported tools and that other use can restrict benefits, and Hutch is not on that list (checked 2026-11-06). The coding endpoint is not offered even with a plan key.

providers.title: OpenCode
providers.notes: Hutch owns a private server process for the managed runtime; the CLI coding handoff is a separate feature that uses its own sign-in. Live-verified 2026-10-30: the managed runtime completed a real step against deepseek/deepseek-flash with matching output and provider-reported tokens and cost.

providers.title: OpenCode Go
providers.notes: A subscription-backed provider API key, not OAuth session reuse. Unattended eligibility is the provider's call and remains unestablished.

providers.title: OpenCode Zen (pay-as-you-go API)
providers.notes: A prepaid-credit API from the OpenCode Console, separate from the OpenCode Go subscription and from the managed OpenCode runtime. It is a gateway: the console translates between native APIs, so the model that answers and its price must be read from the response. The public model list at /inference/v1/models answered HTTP 200 on 2026-11-06 without a key; no key has exercised chat.

providers.title: DeepSeek
providers.notes: OpenAI-shaped chat route at https://api.deepseek.com/v1. The vendor documents legacy model names being re-pointed to a newer served model with unchanged calling method, so the returned model is recorded and never silently assumed. Anthropic-shaped DeepSeek endpoint is not implemented as a separate route.

providers.title: GitHub Copilot
providers.notes: No supported third-party API or CLI authentication contract for Hutch's intended use was established; no unofficial client impersonation is implemented. GitHub documents a Copilot SDK; OpenCode's subscription reuse is not authorized by any GitHub page read and is not implemented.

providers.title: Alibaba Model Studio
providers.notes: Workspace-scoped endpoint https://{WorkspaceId}.{region}.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1; legacy dashscope hosts are migration sources. Keys are region-bound.

providers.title: Xiaomi MiMo
providers.notes: Token Plan is a subscription-credit route with regional hosts; a key works only on its own region. Live-verified on 2026-10-31 for text generation (mimo-v2.6-flash, mimo-v2.6-pro) through the built-in runtime, tool calling and the streamed transport path, speech-to-text (mimo-v2.5-asr) through transcribe_audio, and speech synthesis (mimo-v2.5-tts) through create_media(kind=audio); the synthesized wav was round-trip transcribed. Vision, mp3 input/output, streaming synthesis, non-English audio, voice design/cloning and the cn/ams hosts are not live-verified.

providers.title: Volcengine Ark
providers.notes: The pay-as-you-go /api/v3 endpoint does not draw from a Coding Plan and is billed per token. The plan endpoint /api/coding/v3 is not offered: the vendor lists supported tools and Hutch is not one of them.

providers.title: Tencent Cloud
providers.notes: TokenPlan entitlement is distinct from general Tencent API access. The Token Plan forbids automated scripts, application backends and non-interactive batch use; Hutch bots run unattended, so it is blocked. Pay-as-you-go TokenHub is separate.

providers.title: Baidu Qianfan
providers.notes: OpenAI-compatible v2 endpoint with a bce-v3/ALTAK- key; the OAuth route is documented only.

providers.title: Vydra
providers.notes: Media-only provider (no chat route); no adapter is implemented in this package.

providers.title: Claude Max API proxy (community)
providers.notes: A community integration that bridges a consumer subscription into an API shape. Not first-party, not implemented; policy and security implications unresolved.

providers.title: Amazon Bedrock
providers.notes: Authentication is the AWS credential chain (SigV4) or short- and long-term Bedrock API keys, not a generic provider API key. A Bedrock API key is the only implemented credential. IAM credentials, SigV4 and the native Converse API are documented only. Probed without a key on 2026-11-06.

providers.title: Amazon Bedrock Mantle
providers.notes: A Bedrock API key is the only implemented credential. IAM credentials, SigV4 and the native Converse API are documented only. Probed without a key on 2026-11-06.

providers.title: Google Vertex AI
providers.notes: Authentication is gcloud/ADC with an explicit project and region; it is not an Anthropic-style API key.

providers.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway
providers.notes: A gateway in front of an upstream provider; actual model and upstream route must be recorded from the response. The vendor deprecated the unified /compat API on 2026-10-02; only provider-native routes are documented for single-model calls.

providers.title: Vercel AI Gateway
providers.notes: A unified gateway; a single price or capability claim cannot apply to every model behind it. BYOK requests can fall back to gateway system credentials and bill Vercel credits; routing metadata records the final provider, model and credential type, so it must be captured. BYOK failures fall back to Vercel system credentials billed to the gateway account.

providers.title: OpenRouter
providers.notes: Provider-side routing and fallbacks can answer with a different upstream model than the requested catalogue entry; the returned identity is recorded. The gateway can serve a different final model and bills the served model. Its usage.include parameter is reportedly deprecated while Hutch still sends it: an open compatibility issue, not silently changed.

providers.title: ClawRouter
providers.notes: Hosted default clawrouter.openclaw.ai; keys are issued by an administrator.

providers.title: LiteLLM
providers.notes: model_name is a gateway alias and /v1/models lists aliases; the served upstream model may differ from the requested id.

providers.title: Microsoft Foundry
providers.notes: The model field is a deployment name and auth is an API key or Entra ID; the deployment may not match a public model id. Resource API key through the v1 API (api-key header) is implemented; Microsoft Entra ID is documented only.

providers.title: BytePlus
providers.notes: The pay-as-you-go /api/v3 endpoint is billed per token. A coding-plan endpoint exists at /api/coding/v3 and is not offered until the plan's terms for unlisted tools are confirmed.

providers.title: Ollama Cloud
providers.notes: Hosted inference is not local inference; a cloud-tagged model served by a local daemon stays a hosted route.

providers.title: Ollama
providers.notes: Native /api/chat sets num_ctx explicitly; the OpenAI-compatible endpoint cannot, so prompts can be silently truncated there.

providers.title: SGLang
providers.notes: No bundled named preset; use a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint or a runtime discovery entry.

providers.title: Custom compatible endpoint
providers.notes: A custom endpoint never receives an ambient provider key; only its own named connection key is sent.

providers.title: fal
providers.summary: Queue API for image and video generation, credentialed by the FAL_KEY environment variable.
providers.notes: Routes fal-image and fal-video are protocol-tested only: submit, poll owner/app status URLs, fetch, and a cancel that is confirmed only on HTTP 200 (202 means requested). X-Fal-No-Retry stops fal re-queuing billable work. The key is read from FAL_KEY and labeled ambient; there is no connection template yet. Prices differ per model and are not tabulated. Music models are not built.

providers.title: ComfyUI
providers.summary: A local ComfyUI server driven by a caller-supplied workflow graph, through HUTCH_COMFYUI_URL.
providers.notes: No built-in authentication is documented; Hutch must not expose an unauthenticated ComfyUI instance. Cancel reads the queue and interrupts only a prompt that is ours; outputs of type video, gif and audio are found; downloads are bounded and pass the address policy. Comfy Cloud is not built.

providers.title: Runway
providers.notes: Documented only. The base URL, key-header auth, the X-Runway-Version header, task polling and 24 to 48 hour output expiry are read, but the request body fields and status list come from third-party summaries, so no route is built.

providers.title: PixVerse
providers.summary: Text-to-video through the platform API v2, credentialed by the PIXVERSE_API_KEY environment variable.
providers.notes: Route pixverse-video is protocol-tested only. International host only: keys are regional and a China key does not work here. Moderation status 7 is reported as a refusal. Image-to-video and templates are not built.

providers.title: Deepgram
providers.summary: Aura text to speech, credentialed by the DEEPGRAM_API_KEY environment variable.
providers.notes: Route deepgram-speech is protocol-tested only: 2,000 characters per request, wav output. Transcription is not built through this provider.

providers.title: ElevenLabs
providers.summary: Text to speech, credentialed by the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable.
providers.notes: Route elevenlabs-speech is protocol-tested only. Music, sound effects, transcription and voice cloning are not built; voice cloning needs clear consent and abuse safeguards before Hutch exposes it.
